name: gramafix-server
description: GramaFix Express & MongoDB REST API Server

scripts.predev: powershell -Command "$p = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess | Where-Object { $_ -ne 0 } | Sort-Object -Unique; if ($p) { Stop-Process -Id $p -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"
